purpose: Compare ordinary warm Hapsland builds before and after process-local evidence reuse, and record bounded correctness checks.
status: Completed local implementation and validation evidence.
authority: Implementation/validation evidence; accepted build goals remain in issue #243 and maintained repository guidance. This is not a product contract or platform qualification.
expectedUse: Review the measured optimization and reproduce it with the identified source and toolchain; distinguish warm timing from cold preparation and correctness acceptance.
lifecycle: Retain as source-bound validation evidence. Source/toolchain or filesystem trust-boundary changes require a new measurement, not rewriting these observations.

sharedOverlay.reason: Primary-worktree provider registry literal keys make the unchanged source loader checker admit master. Applied identically before and after; no timing gain attributed to this fix.

environment.bend: 2.0.35 (pinned tool directory; Bend has no --version option)

measurement.timingMethod: performance.now elapsed around existing runBuildProcess until owned group drain; terminal logs and cache event parsing performed afterwards.
measurement.cacheState: Task/output caches prepared for each source variant before measurement; same isolated container, installed dependencies and pinned tools. Producer restoration still runs fresh source/compiler/native/assembly/publication guards.

reverseControl.order: After acceptance, restore the three original helper files, run baseline, restore the final helpers, run candidate; both remained complete cache hits.

limitations: Warm ordinary build entry only; npm launch overhead excluded.
Preparation and cache invalidation rebuilds excluded; no cold improvement claim.
Host load and OS page cache were uncontrolled; three ordered runs and a later reverse control do not establish a population performance guarantee.
Linux ARM64 only. Darwin retains descriptor-checked full hashing; Darwin performance and installed runtime compatibility were not measured.
Digest reuse trusts local Linux metadata like the existing dependency memo; it is not authentication against a hostile filesystem/cache writer.
prerequisiteFailureExplanation: Initial preparation had no Bend executable in PATH; corrected to the pinned Bend directory before measurement.
An initial Linux preparation selected different physical Bun paths at root and task boundaries; pinning HAPSLAND_BUILD_BUN=/usr/local/bin/bun consistently resolved the identity mismatch.

outputs.interpretation: Nine non-executable release files retained exact bytes/modes. The five executables were rebuilt under new assembly inputs and differ by digest; all five before/after --help outputs are identical. Selected production restoration separately proved exact restored bytes/modes against its own frozen baseline.

fast.scope: Generated docs, source typing, package graph, release identity, development imports and changed-file lint; completed locally on final production helper inputs.

buildWorkflow.command: Testing matrix build-workflow stage via precheckStages and spawnSync, timeout 150000ms

fileLoaderNativeFreshness.command: node --test scripts/compiler-evidence.test.mjs scripts/external-loader-profile.test.mjs scripts/check-assembly-receipt.test.mjs scripts/external-runtime-evidence.test.mjs scripts/native-task-receipt.test.mjs scripts/native-toolchain-inputs.test.mjs scripts/dependency-digests.test.mjs
fileLoaderNativeFreshness.cases: Same-size edits with restored mtime, chmod/replacement/deletion, symlink/directory replacement, descriptor read/hit races, fresh resolver/target bytes/ownership/approval, native dependency/PATH/search candidate changes and corrupt namespace memo.

declaration.expectedDuration: 3 selected cases; 3–5 minutes per case, including baseline and required repairs

productionAcceptance.identityEncoding: Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)), UTF-8. This is a compact reference to the locally retained full authored identity; source files above identify changed helpers.
productionAcceptance.deadlineNote: Runner declaration preserves its generic 300000ms per-run ceiling. This campaign supplied a 240000ms total deadline, and every concrete run was limited to remaining campaign time; no check received more than 240 seconds.

rawEvidence: Raw terminal logs, source snapshots and full acceptance report are retained locally in ignored .test-runs/build-evidence-reuse; this tracked record retains cache events, source identities, output inventories, probes and terminal acceptance summaries.
